PROFILE::clientssl
Description
Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned
Client SSL profile.
Syntax
PROFILE
::
clientssl
<
profile_setting
>
PROFILE::clientssl <profile_setting>
Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned
Client SSL profile.
